title: Kentia Palm Double, Howea Forsteriana
description:
Kentia Palm, Bring Indoors to Uplift the Spirit and Create a Tropical Look, Rare and Exotic Palm.

Howea forsteriana Kentia Palm, is a clustering palm that can make any sunlit room feel like a tropical haven. This fast-growing easy-care palm enjoys bright spaces and moderate watering to maintain soil moist. The Kentia Palm is an excellent addition to any living room, office or patio, Kentia Palm also does well outdoors snug alongside a sun-drenched patio or nearby water feature for a lush tropical feel. They grow in an upright habit and are one of the easiest palm trees to grow. Now is your opportunity to own one of a kind, exotic and difficult to find Kentia Palm.

WHY PURCHASE FROM EUREKA FARMS, We offer exceptional service and attention to quality. We grow and care for our plants, from beginning to end. We carefully inspect and hand select the highest quality available plant for your enjoyment. We promise to ship plants that are healthy and beautiful. We carefully wrap and secure the plant for a save journey to you.

This elegant palm tree is great for indoors, patios or decks, it must remain under shade, keep away from direct sunlight. This magnificent ornamental plant is very unique, is native to the tropics of Southern Asia, is a very rare and hardy plant and can tolerate drought better than most other palms.

Focal Specimen: Kentia Palm can also be used as a focal point. Place it in a main entrance or a living room, it simply demands attention, this rare and exotic plant will demand attention from everyone that visits.
